notes.title: Announcement of the game Red Passport: Ticket to Russia!
notes.notes: [p]Ready for an unforgettable adventure?[/p][p]I present to you [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3833430/Red_Passport_Ticket_to_Russia/"]Red Passport: Ticket to Russia[/url] — a new game in development that will transport you on a thrilling journey across the boundless expanses of Russia![/p][p]Begin your journey in a cozy apartment, where the first puzzles and decisions await you. Then head to the airport to board a plane and fly off to another city. But that's just the beginning! An epic train ride awaits you through picturesque landscapes, leading straight to Vladivostok![/p]

notes.title: Red October: Watch gameplay from the trip!
notes.notes:
Work on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2905620/Red_October/]Red October[/url] is boiling, and I'm happy to show you a new gameplay video! This time I show you a train ride - one of the gameplay scenes. Take a peek behind the scenes of development and watch the train carriage come to life, full of interactive gizmos and realistic physics.

In this video, I control the character, walking around the train car, touching everything and using items. I tried to make everything as cool and realistic as possible:

[olist]
[*] Moving around the car: Watch how smoothly the character moves as he walks down the aisle, looks into compartments, and interacts with different objects.
[*] Object Physics: Things in the train car are not just standing there! They react to the player's actions, just like in real life. You can pick up a newspaper, move a suitcase or open a window - everything looks natural.
[*] Interactive environment: You can open the door to the next compartment, look out the window and look at the scenery - the world of Red October is alive! I wanted to make everything as interactive as possible, so you feel like you're inside the game.
[/olist]
[previewyoutube=yPKGEW14K88;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Game update from 01/24/2024
notes.notes:
Dear friends, today a new game update has been released, many changes have been made, namely:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where sometimes the player fell through the ground.
[*] Added new sounds when the train moves.
[*] Fixed a bug where the mouse cursor would freeze when talking to other characters
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could not jump into a passenger car.
[*] Fixed errors in dialogue texts
[/list]

We would also like to announce the development of a new game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2757610/TransSiberian_Express/]Trans-Siberian Express[/url]. Details on the page.

notes.title: Russian Train Trip update!
notes.notes:
Long time no news from us.

We have released an update that improves the game's performance: optimizations have been made, and the light at night has been corrected. Now game will not slow down at night.

notes.title: Update 4.3 is out
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Important update 4.3 released

List of changes:
[olist]
[*] The most important bug has been removed: when the character sat down in the carriage and got up, he found himself in the sky. Now there is no such bug.
[*] Added snow on the ground when choosing the "Snow" weather at the beginning of the game. Now the game looks even better!
[*] Minor changes in the route.
[/olist]

Update 5.0 is being prepared for release. Details will come later.

notes.title: Update 4.2
notes.notes:
Update 4.2 was released today, bringing the following additions:

[list]
[*] Added languages: Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Chinese,
[*] Minor optimization of the game, performance improvement by 5-10%.
[*] Fixed bugs in the form of flying trees.
[*] Replaced images of the menu and loading screen.
[/list]
